newsitem.title: USA: Successories Inc Q1 May 3 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Successories Inc Q1 May 3 loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: '97 Q1 net includes non-cash expense of $187,000, or $0.03 a share, related to issuance of warrants for common stock issued in connection with extending the due date for subordinated debt.
NOTE: '97 Q1 results reflect 10 fewer company owned retail stores open than in the same period in 1996.
'97 Q1 earnings figures include a non-cash provision for preferred dividends of $380,000, or $0.07 a share.
'96 Q1 results include an income-tax benefit of $539,000 generated from prior period losses.
'97 Q1 loss from operations was $753,000, a 19 percent improvement from a loss of $932,000 for the same period in 1996, the company said.
